name: Read whether the Tier 2 Government change window remains open

condition.code: local p=Players[Game.GetLocalPlayer()]; return p and p:IsTurnActive() and type(ExposedMembers.JAC_PersonaBoundary)=='table'

steps.code: local b=ExposedMembers.JAC_PersonaBoundary; local g=b.ReadCapacityGovernment('Tier2'); local p=b.CaptiveCapacityPlan(); local a=Game:GetProperty('JAC_BOUNDARY_TIER2_CIVIC_ATTEMPT'); local d=b.EnemyRetryDiagnosis(); assert(d.spyID==655368 and d.eventID==0 and d.eventTurn==23 and d.mission.turn==23 and d.outcome=='CAPTURED' and d.occupied==1 and d.captive.captor==1 and d.captive.nameIndex==-1,'original captive changed'); return 'plan='..p.stage..' government='..g.stage..' current='..g.currentType..' civicThisTurn='..tostring(g.civicCompletedThisTurn)..' sourceTurn='..tostring(a and a.turn)..' now='..Game.GetCurrentGameTurn()
